decisions.evidence: R4 maker: 'app opens directly to a save box, uses one clear save button' + saves the pasted address. R4 client: 'I paste the address, hit the one button... this feels right.'
decisions.note: Save-by-URL conforms to reference; recorded conforming decision (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R4 maker enumerates auto-fill of only 'title and description'; favicon/preview image never mentioned in any round, and list cards never expose a favicon. R4 client accepts the save flow without mentioning favicon or preview image.
decisions.note: REF-BM-02 requires auto-collecting favicon and preview image (and REF-BM-07 exposing favicon per item); presented scope omits both and the client never raised them (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R4 maker presents only the save flow (no editing of collected fields). R4 client: 'I'd expect to be able to tweak that filled-in title or description — either right as I save it or later.'
decisions.note: Client requests editing of auto-collected title/description before and after saving — a related reference requirement absent from the presented save-only scope (extend). Realized conformingly at R5-R7.

decisions.evidence: R8 maker: 'keep the collection at one link, explain that it was already saved, and bring the existing bookmark into focus.' R8 client: 'It didn't make a second copy... pulled the existing one into focus... kept my edited title.'
decisions.note: Re-saving an existing url guides to the existing bookmark — conforms to reference (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R9 maker: 'assumed search checks both titles and descriptions... check whether that scope is right.' R9 client: 'I don't just want it looking at the title and description... also find a link by any personal note... and by the web address itself... the title, the description, my own notes, and the address.'
decisions.note: Presented full-text scope (title+description) under-fulfils REF-BM-12 (title, description, note, url); client supplies the reference-conforming field set (correct). Realized at R10.

decisions.evidence: Search defined at R9/R10 as plain field matching; '#tag' syntax never presented or requested. Client (R9/R10/R33) discusses only field coverage and case-insensitivity.
decisions.note: REF-BM-14 (#tag search syntax) omitted from the presented search scope and never surfaced by the client (prototype review / scope gate).

decisions.evidence: R9/R10 search presentations show only substring matching; AND/OR/NOT operators and parenthesised groups never presented or requested anywhere.
decisions.note: REF-BM-15 (boolean operators / parentheses, with operator-quoting rule) omitted and never raised by the client.

decisions.evidence: No round presents or requests quoted-phrase exact-match search; client search feedback (R9/R10/R26/R33) never mentions phrases.
decisions.note: REF-BM-16 (quoted phrase exact match) omitted and unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: R11 maker: 'assumed a note... uses a plain text box.' R11 client: 'I'd like to be able to add a bit of light formatting in the note and have it actually show up nicely formatted when I read it back — not just as plain runs of text.'
decisions.note: Presented plain-text note diverges from REF-BM-23 (markdown note rendered on view); client supplies the reference-conforming formatted/rendered behaviour (correct). Realized at R12.

decisions.evidence: R14 maker presents label browsing/counts/overlap only. R14 client: 'I'd expect to be able to put these labels on a bookmark myself — when I save it or when I edit it — and... have it suggest labels I've already used as I type, so I don't accidentally make a slightly different duplicate.'
decisions.note: Client requests self-assignment of tags (REF-BM-09) and autocomplete of existing tags (REF-BM-10), both absent from the browse-only presentation (extend). Realized at R15.

decisions.evidence: R14 maker: clicking a label filters to its bookmarks. R14 client: 'clicking "Cooking" pulling up just my two cooking links, in one click.'
decisions.note: Select-a-tag-to-filter conforms to REF-BM-11 (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R17 maker: 'click Save bookmark... whether the saved card makes it clear that Cooking stayed attached.' R17 client: 'what I'm looking at doesn't show me the saved result — it's still the Review... screen... labels box... is actually empty... Could you show me the actual saved card, with Cooking already picked.'
decisions.note: Presented artifact failed to demonstrate the tag persisting onto the saved bookmark (REF-BM-09); client rejects the mismatch and states the expected saved state (correct). Resolved at R18. Same requirement as R14 at a later implementation/prototype point.

decisions.evidence: R30 maker asks about case/space-insensitive label matching; R10/R33 client: search 'didn't care about capitals.' Case-insensitive behaviour affirmed conformingly.
decisions.note: Case-insensitive matching conforms to REF-BM-13 (specification gate / implementation review).

decisions.evidence: R21 maker: 'read-later is a simple on/off choice... doesn't remove the link from the main collection.' R21 client: 'flipping Add to Read later on... feels right... just an on/off marker that doesn't pull the link out of my main collection.'
decisions.note: Mark-as-read-later conforms to REF-BM-17 (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R21 maker presents only the on/off read-later marker. R21 client: 'I'd expect a way to see just my read-later items in one place... and then, once I've read something, to mark it as done so it drops off that reading list (but stays saved).'
decisions.note: Client requests a separate unread view (REF-BM-18) and mark-as-read removal (REF-BM-19), both absent from the presented marker scope (extend). Realized at R22.

decisions.evidence: Every list presentation (R4, R9, R22) fixes ordering as 'newest-first'; no selectable sort key is ever offered or requested. R9 client: 'newest first, is fine too.'
decisions.note: REF-BM-22 (sort by a chosen sort key: date, title, etc.) reduced to a fixed default; the divergence passed without the client expressing the difference.

decisions.evidence: Deleting a bookmark is never presented or demonstrated across R4-R33; R32 scope summary omits it. R33 client alludes to deletion existing ('without deleting them') but never specified/tested it.
decisions.note: REF-BM-05 (delete a bookmark) absent from presented scope and never co-constructed (specification gate).

decisions.evidence: No round presents or tests that selecting a list item opens the original url; client feedback never mentions navigating to the link.
decisions.note: REF-BM-08 (selecting an item navigates to the original url) omitted and unexpressed (specification gate).

decisions.evidence: Multi-select and bulk actions (add/remove tags, read/unread, archive, delete) never presented; R32 scope enumeration excludes them and client approves without mention.
decisions.note: REF-BM-20 (select multiple bookmarks for a bulk action) omitted and unexpressed (specification gate).

decisions.evidence: Applying a bulk action to the whole filtered collection never presented or requested anywhere; R32 scope omits it.
decisions.note: REF-BM-21 (bulk action over the whole current-filter collection) omitted and unexpressed (specification gate).

decisions.evidence: R32 scope summary (16 scenarios) omits snapshots. R33 client, while accepting: 'I'd still love to eventually get to a couple of things we didn't take up this time, like... a keepsake copy of a page in case it vanishes. Just noting those for a future round; they don't hold up my acceptance.'
decisions.note: Client explicitly names the snapshot requirement (REF-BM-24) as omitted and accepts the departure without requesting alignment (accepted_divergence). Divergence established at R32 gate; expression/acceptance at R33 implementation review — linked, counted once.

decisions.evidence: Internet Archive snapshot never presented; R33 client's 'keepsake copy' names only a local snapshot, not an Internet Archive one.
decisions.note: REF-BM-25 (Internet Archive snapshot) omitted and unexpressed; distinct from the accepted local-snapshot expression (specification gate).

decisions.evidence: R32 scope omits archiving. R33 client: 'I'd still love to eventually get to... tidying away links I'm done with without deleting them... Just noting those for a future round; they don't hold up my acceptance today.'
decisions.note: Client explicitly states the archive requirement — hide/set-aside without deleting (REF-BM-26), distinct from deletion (REF-BM-27) — and accepts deferring it (accepted_divergence). Divergence at R32 gate; expression/acceptance at R33.

decisions.evidence: A separate archived-bookmarks list is never presented or requested; R33 client's archive mention does not name a dedicated archive view.
decisions.note: REF-BM-28 (view only archived bookmarks) omitted and unexpressed (specification gate).

decisions.evidence: Saving a search-term + included/excluded-tag combination as a reusable bundle is never presented or requested; R32 scope omits it.
decisions.note: REF-BM-29 (bundles / saved filters) omitted and unexpressed (specification gate).

decisions.evidence: Netscape-HTML import never presented or requested in any round; R32 scope omits it.
decisions.note: REF-BM-30 (import bookmarks in Netscape HTML) omitted and unexpressed (specification gate).

decisions.evidence: Netscape-HTML export never presented or requested; R32 scope omits it.
decisions.note: REF-BM-31 (export bookmarks in Netscape HTML) omitted and unexpressed (specification gate).

decisions.evidence: Personal display settings (default sort, displayed items, font size) never presented or requested; R32 scope omits the user-settings entity.
decisions.note: REF-BM-32 (adjust display-related personal settings) omitted and unexpressed (specification gate).
